    ]]>

  <?db-info status="active"?>
]>

  <log:entry audit:id="1005">
    <?audit-pi timestamp="2023-10-01"?>

    ]]>
    <record>&internal-entity;</record>
  </log:entry>
</database>

<!DOCTYPE catalog [
  <!ELEMENT catalog (item)*>
  <!ELEMENT item (#PCDATA)>
  <!ENTITY base "CatalogBase">
  <!ENTITY ref "&base;Extension">
  <!ENTITY % dtd-macro "<!ELEMENT macro-elem (#PCDATA)>">
  %dtd-macro;
  <?catalog-meta version="2.0"?>
]>
<catalog xmlns="http://schema.org/catalog" xmlns:xi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XInclude">
  <!-- Top-level comment before CDATA and entity reference -->
  <item>
    <![CDATA[
      <![CDATA[ Nested-looking CDATA construct test ]]>
    ]]>
  </item>
  <item>&ref;</item>
  <xi:include href="fallback.xml"/>
</catalog>

<!DOCTYPE document [
  <!ELEMENT document (section)*>
  <!ELEMENT section (#PCDATA)>
  <!ENTITY author "John Doe">
  <!ENTITY email "john@example.com">
  <?doc-info author="&author;"?>
  <!NOTATION pdf SYSTEM "application/pdf">
  <!ENTITY manual SYSTEM "manual.pdf" NDATA pdf>
]>
<document xmlns="http://doc.org/ns" xmlns:xhtml="http://www.w3.org/1999/xhtml" xmlns:dc="http://purl.org/dc/elements/1.1/">
  <!-- Metadata comment block -->
  <xhtml:div>
    <?xhtml-script type="text/javascript"?>
    <![CDATA[
      <xhtml:script>alert("XSS via CDATA");</xhtml:script>
    ]]>
  </xhtml:div>
  <section dc:creator="&author;">Contact: &email;</section>
</document>
